Anika (PM): Quick spike idea: allow inline edits to scorecards directly from the regression-diff list so reviewers can tweak weights/comments without opening the full scorecard modal. Goal: speed up triage for small changes.
Theo (Design): I like that. Key UX questions: where to put edit affordance without adding clutter? My mock shows a tiny pencil at top-right of the compact scorecard peek that flips the peek to edit mode. Link: https://figma.com/file/inline-scorecard-edit
Ravi (Frontend): Implementation notes: inline editing will need optimistic updates and undo. We should cap live edits per-run (e.g., only allow edits when run.status == "review"). Also watch for race when two reviewers edit same test.
Maya (A11y): Accessibility: inline edit form must be reachable via keyboard and have proper labels. Suggest using role="dialog" for the in-place editor and trap focus while editing. Provide aria-live notifications for save success/failure.
Jon (Data): If edits change scoring weights, we need to snapshot the evaluation metrics pre/post and show the delta — otherwise auditors get confused. Ideally store both original and edited scorecards on the run object.
Anika (PM): Good point. UX: show a subtle delta chip next to the score (e.g., "+0.8 pts") after save, with hover to view before/after. Also need an audit trail entry: who changed what and why.
Theo (Design): For compactness, edit mode should collapse non-essential fields and show only weight sliders + comment. We should hide advanced options behind "More" to keep density low.
Ravi (Frontend): Technical: prefer to POST patch to /runs/:id/scorecard-edits and return a diff summary. We'll show optimistic delta then reconcile on response. Add toast: "Scorecard updated (undo)" with 10s undo.
Maya (A11y): Undo must be keyboard-activatable and announced by screen readers. Also color contrast for delta chips: avoid green/red pairs only, include textual sign (+/-) and an accessible label.
Jon (Data): We'll add metrics: pre_score, post_score, pct_change and a flag if change affects approval gate. CI bot can run a small evaluation to verify no regression.
ci-bot: evaluation-note: snapshot job queued -> https://ci.redwood.ai/job/scorecard-snapshots/1762501234
Anika (PM): Edge cases: 1) concurrent edits -> show merge conflict UI (tiny banner: "Another reviewer changed this scorecard. Review changes?"); 2) edits for past runs should be immutable.
Ravi (Frontend): Agree about immutability. We'll only enable edit affordance when run.is_active_review == true. For conflicts we'll surface the server diff and offer "keep mine / accept theirs / merge".
Theo (Design): Will add microcopy for merge states. Proposed CTA copy in inline editor: Primary = "Save changes", Secondary = "Cancel"; Undo toast copy = "Changes saved. Undo?"
Maya (A11y): Also request: keyboard shortcuts for editor: Enter = save, Escape = cancel. Add tests for NVDA and VoiceOver.
Anika (PM): Plan: Theo + Ravi prototype inline editor prototype this week, Jon to add snapshot fields, Maya to draft accessibility checklist, I'll file a brief product RFC for review. Thanks! :rocket:
